# Introduction

Unadjusted ANCOVA analyses with Treatment*Molecular Category (Full vs Mosaic) interaction using all data (Eng + Fr speakers). These analyses
compare Week 16 outcomes between treatment groups while adjusting for
baseline values and site (and total number of utterances for the ELS measures), and include
an interaction term between Treatment and Molecular Category.

Results are stratified by molecular category, showing treatment effects separately for
Full and Mosaic methylation participants, along with the p-value for the interaction term.

```{r}
#| label: export-tables
#| echo: false
#| include: false

strata <- "molecular_interaction_unadjusted"

# Create workbook
wb <- openxlsx2::wb_workbook()

# Add ELS as primary table
wb <- openxlsx2::wb_add_worksheet(wb, sheet = "Primary - ELS")
wb <- flexlsx::wb_add_flextable(wb, sheet = "Primary - ELS", ft = els_ancova_intrxn_unadj_ft)

# Add individual instrument tables
wb <- openxlsx2::wb_add_worksheet(wb, sheet = "BMI")
wb <- flexlsx::wb_add_flextable(wb, sheet = "BMI", ft = bmi_ancova_intrxn_unadj_ft)

wb <- openxlsx2::wb_add_worksheet(wb, sheet = "ABC")
wb <- flexlsx::wb_add_flextable(wb, sheet = "ABC", ft = abc_ancova_intrxn_unadj_ft)

wb <- openxlsx2::wb_add_worksheet(wb, sheet = "ADAMS")
wb <- flexlsx::wb_add_flextable(wb, sheet = "ADAMS", ft = adams_ancova_intrxn_unadj_ft)

wb <- openxlsx2::wb_add_worksheet(wb, sheet = "Peds QL")
wb <- flexlsx::wb_add_flextable(wb, sheet = "Peds QL", ft = pql_ancova_intrxn_unadj_ft)

wb <- openxlsx2::wb_add_worksheet(wb, sheet = "CSHQ")
wb <- flexlsx::wb_add_flextable(wb, sheet = "CSHQ", ft = cshq_ancova_intrxn_unadj_ft)

wb <- openxlsx2::wb_add_worksheet(wb, sheet = "SNAP-IV")
wb <- flexlsx::wb_add_flextable(wb, sheet = "SNAP-IV", ft = snap_ancova_intrxn_unadj_ft)

wb <- openxlsx2::wb_add_worksheet(wb, sheet = "VAS")
wb <- flexlsx::wb_add_flextable(wb, sheet = "VAS", ft = vas_ancova_intrxn_unadj_ft)

wb <- openxlsx2::wb_add_worksheet(wb, sheet = "CGI")
wb <- flexlsx::wb_add_flextable(wb, sheet = "CGI", ft = cgi_ancova_intrxn_unadj_ft)

wb <- openxlsx2::wb_add_worksheet(wb, sheet = "Vineland")
wb <- flexlsx::wb_add_flextable(wb, sheet = "Vineland", ft = vabs_ancova_intrxn_unadj_ft)

wb <- openxlsx2::wb_add_worksheet(wb, sheet = "Biomarkers")
wb <- flexlsx::wb_add_flextable(wb, sheet = "Biomarkers", ft = biomarker_ancova_intrxn_unadj_ft)

wb <- openxlsx2::wb_add_worksheet(wb, sheet = "Toolbox")
wb <- flexlsx::wb_add_flextable(wb, sheet = "Toolbox", ft = tlbx_ancova_intrxn_unadj_ft)

wb <- openxlsx2::wb_add_worksheet(wb, sheet = "Eye Tracking")
wb <- flexlsx::wb_add_flextable(wb, sheet = "Eye Tracking", ft = eye_ancova_z_intrxn_unadj_ft)

# Combine all other instruments into secondary outcomes table
secondary_tbl <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  BMI = bmi_ancova_intrxn_unadj_summary,
  ABC = abc_ancova_intrxn_unadj_summary,
  ADAMS = adams_ancova_intrxn_unadj_summary,
  PedsQL = pql_ancova_intrxn_unadj_summary,
  CSHQ = cshq_ancova_intrxn_unadj_summary,
  `SNAP-IV` = snap_ancova_intrxn_unadj_summary,
  VAS = vas_ancova_intrxn_unadj_summary,
  Vineland = vabs_ancova_intrxn_unadj_summary,
  Biomarkers = biomarker_ancova_intrxn_unadj_summary,
  Toolbox = tlbx_ancova_intrxn_unadj_summary,
  `Eye Tracking` = eye_ancova_z_intrxn_unadj_summary,
  .id = "Instrument"
)

# Format secondary outcomes table
secondary_ft <- secondary_tbl |>
  dplyr::select(-interaction_p) |>
  flextable::as_grouped_data(groups = "Instrument") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Outcome = ifelse(
      is.na(Outcome),
      Instrument,
      Outcome
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(-Instrument) |>
  flextable::flextable() |>
  flextable::set_header_labels(
    Outcome = "Outcome",
    strata_label = strata_label,
    n_p = "N",
    baseline_p = "Baseline",
    baseline_p_ci = "95% CI",
    week16_p = "Week 16",
    week16_p_ci = "95% CI",
    p_change = "Change",
    p_change_ci = "95% CI",
    n_m = "N",
    baseline_m = "Baseline",
    baseline_m_ci = "95% CI",
    week16_m = "Week 16",
    week16_m_ci = "95% CI",
    m_change = "Change",
    m_change_ci = "95% CI",
    baseline_contrast_mean = "Baseline Diff",
    baseline_contrast_ci = "95% CI",
    contrast_mean = "Change Diff",
    contrast_ci = "95% CI",
    interaction_est = "Interaction Estimate",
    interaction_ci = "95% CI"
  ) |>
  flextable::add_header_row(
    values = c("", "", "Placebo", "Metformin", "Between-Group Differences", ""),
    colwidths = c(1, 1, 7, 7, 4, 2)
  ) |>
  flextable::merge_v(j = c("Outcome", "interaction_est", "interaction_ci")) |>
  flextable::theme_vanilla() |>
  flextable::align(i = 1, align = "left", part = "header") |>
  flextable::align(i = 2, align = "center", part = "header") |>
  flextable::align(j = 1:2, align = "left", part = "all") |>
  flextable::align(j = c(21, 22), align = "center", part = "body") |>
  flextable::vline(j = c(2, 9, 16), part = "all") |>
  flextable::autofit()

wb <- openxlsx2::wb_add_worksheet(wb, sheet = "Secondary Outcomes")
wb <- flexlsx::wb_add_flextable(wb, sheet = "Secondary Outcomes", ft = secondary_ft)

# Save model result tables (not flextables) for each instrument
ancova_model_results_tables <- list(
  ELS = els_ancova_intrxn_unadj_summary,
  BMI = bmi_ancova_intrxn_unadj_summary,
  ABC = abc_ancova_intrxn_unadj_summary,
  ADAMS = adams_ancova_intrxn_unadj_summary,
  PedsQL = pql_ancova_intrxn_unadj_summary,
  CSHQ = cshq_ancova_intrxn_unadj_summary,
  `SNAP-IV` = snap_ancova_intrxn_unadj_summary,
  VAS = vas_ancova_intrxn_unadj_summary,
  CGI = cgi_ancova_intrxn_unadj_summary,
  Vineland = vabs_ancova_intrxn_unadj_summary,
  Biomarkers = biomarker_ancova_intrxn_unadj_summary,
  Toolbox = tlbx_ancova_intrxn_unadj_summary,
  `Eye Tracking` = eye_ancova_z_intrxn_unadj_summary
)

saveRDS(
  object = ancova_model_results_tables,
  file = glue::glue("metformin_{strata}_ancova_model_results_tables.rds")
)

# Save workbook
openxlsx2::wb_save(
  wb = wb,
  file = glue::glue("{Sys.Date()}_metformin_{strata}_ancova_tables.xlsx"),
  overwrite = TRUE
)
```
